# CalcHub

> CalcHub is a modern collection of practical calculators and utilities for everyday math, conversions, dates, passwords, and productivity tasks.

## Overview

CalcHub helps users solve common numeric and utility problems quickly through a clean, responsive web experience. The site focuses on accessible tools for students, professionals, and general everyday use.

## Main tools

- [Scientific Calculator](https://calccode.com/scientific-calculator)
- [Age Calculator](https://calccode.com/age-calculator)

- [BMI Calculator](https://calccode.com/bmi-calculator)
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calccode.com/percentage-calculator)
- [Unit Converter](https://calccode.com/unit-converter)
- [Date Difference](https://calccode.com/date-difference)
